node.statement: Instantiate lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger with exactly the witnesses fixed above, in particular the same C_unit,epsilon_unit,delta_unit,a_unit and the same Stage-1 envelope witnesses; choose its valid enlarged c0 and fix its one furnished datum W and D_*=max{1,D_0,D_1,D_2,D_3}. The external gives W.c0_cb=c0, W.K1>=K_1^0, W.e1<=e_1, and eligibility of its Stage-1 literal call for the reset thresholds. Hence D_*>=1 and W.K1>=K_1^0>=1; because the reset-threshold witnesses are the identical ones fixed from lem-maincb-reset-output-typing, that eligibility supplies precisely the W.c0_cb and W.r_reset scalar antecedents of that typed-reset lemma.
